inlines.v: PAM'PER, verb transitive [Latin bibo.] 1. To feed to the full; to glut; to saginate; to feed luxuriously; as, to pamper the body or the appetite. We are proud of a body fattening for worms and pampered for corruption and the grave. 2. To gratify to the full; to furnish with that which delights; as, to pamper the imagination.
